files.notes: Per-user preference JSON in system config; trim validation 500 runes, newest-first max20, read/parse failure becomes empty. Unsynchronized read-modify-write can lose concurrent edits.
JWT chat and streaming inject store-user context and execution-capable session policy; sensitive secrets disabled. Public agent market endpoints separately registered.
Registry metadata plus three actual shared resolver results; no cfg omits resolved. Direct trader-manager lookup lacks owner check.
Public crypto configuration/key; decrypt protected and transport-encryption gated. Private-key helper checks length/prefix only.
Structured safe JSON errors, server-side logging, heuristic sensitive substring/IP-like filtering; not a universal error scrubber.
NT TCP account list, persisted binding distinct from streamed current; SIM/allowlist checked. Select resets memory then persists and returns success even on error; ownership gap.
Scoped model reads with secret omission, encryption-conditional config writes, SSRF URL validation; thinking validation after base write, warning-only thinking/reload failure; entry CRUD.
Explicit ownership check; TEST-E2 place/place_stop/cancel dispatches actual AutoTrader methods; feature flag and SIM enforcement delegated downstream.
Single-use ticket establishes user; scoped query resolver; snapshot and lastT-based 1s deltas, 15s keepalive, context cancellation. Older backfill updates omitted after lastT.
Owned query APIs and public competition/equity paths coexist. Single history uses unrealized/base; batch uses equity-minus-initial percentage and may append live point.
Scoped futures/TCP resolution; runtime symbol changes feature-gated, legacy debug unsubscribe separate; test trade routes directly to broker debug helper.
Audit since parsing UTC date/RFC3339, default7d/100; manager lookup unscoped; optional account filter passed to store.
Direct manager lookup and DeskStripAt(now); caller clock and unknown handling delegated; ownership gap.
Global read model with view and era filtering, min_n and exclusion metadata; no per-user scope; 200 empty rows plus error on load failure.
Provider dispatch; NT same market hook no alternate feed; crypto fallbacks, context.Background external fetches; TwelveData parse failure leaves zero slot.
Claw402 wallet find/adopt/generate; returns key, writes global env and .env; per-user model storage but shared process persistence; file rewrite non-atomic.
Thin structural geometry store reader; WARN and nil when unavailable.
First open DB position entry-version identity, distinguishes missing attribution; no account selection and only first row displayed.

Trader lifecycle create/update/delete/start/stop/pause/resume, localized validation helpers. NT start binding required. Unix-second IDs; unsafe unowned delete flow; asynchronous run and warning-only reload/status errors.
Grid read, initial-balance sync, manual broker close. NT reuses bound live TCP; other brokers temp instances; non-synced close records manufacture price/fee/FILLED state.
Global registry records docs and Gin route; schema injected verbatim to LLM; repeated server construction appends duplicate docs; unknown verbs documented but not mounted.

Gin public/protected boundaries, prefix-limited ownership middleware, query resolver, JWT blacklist verification, loopback default listener; no HTTP timeouts configured here; substantial route prose drift.
Scoped strategy CRUD/merge/clamp/period validation; token overflow check after persistence; reload bound traders. Prompt preview/test analysis, optional provider call, observational config diffs.
Mask secrets and email for logs; URL/wallet metadata stays unmasked; byte slicing for masks.
